note: Partial pass: 3 of 7 subsystem batches (border+gameevent, item, material) were not run this pass and remain unchecked. Do not treat sample_size below as covering those subsystems.

results.note: gravity-support check and post-place tick scheduling match vanilla FallingBlock.java (getDelayAfterPlace=2, isFree logic) in pumpkin/src/block/blocks/falling.rs.
useWithoutItem stat award + menu open matches CraftingTableBlock.java in pumpkin/src/block/blocks/crafting_table.rs.

pumpkin/src/block/blocks/plant/twisting_vines.rs:82 checks is_side_solid(Down) but vanilla's GrowingPlantBlock.canSurvive requires the support's growthDirection (UP) face to be sturdy -- wrong face, still broken despite prior PR #2604 claiming a fix.
8-tick activation delay and signal levels match LightningRodBlock.java; only cosmetic spark particle/level-event omitted (non-gameplay).
registry/dispatch surface plausibly covers comparable behavior categories to vanilla Blocks.java groupings.

vanilla Tilt carries a causesVibration field consumed by BigDripleafBlock to emit GameEvent.BLOCK_CHANGE; pumpkin's generated Tilt enum has no such data and big_dripleaf.rs:212 has a //todo with no vibration emission at all -- sculk sensors never detect dripleaf tilt changes.

vanilla Donkey.java has canMate/getBreedOffspring for donkey x horse -> mule crossbreeding; pumpkin/src/entity/passive/donkey.rs registers no BreedGoal at all -- donkey breeding is entirely unimplemented.
stats (health/speed/attack/follow-range) and target priorities match PiglinBrute.java exactly; architectural Brain-vs-Goal-selector gap is expected and doesn't change observable behavior.
generated entity_type.rs dimensions/categories/attribute defaults for sampled entries match vanilla EntityTypes.java registrations.

vanilla's entire puff-state/contact-damage/poison mechanic (Pufferfish.java) is absent from pumpkin/src/entity/passive/pufferfish.rs -- only basic AI goals are registered, no puff state, no poison-on-touch.

vanilla rejects the whole goal if the globally-closest adult is under the min distance, even if a farther valid parent exists; pumpkin/src/entity/ai/goal/follow_parent.rs instead skips too-close candidates and follows a farther one -- observably different behavior in the close-parent case.

vanilla RangedAttribute clamps every computed value into a per-attribute [min,max]; pumpkin/src/entity/attributes.rs and the generated Attributes struct have no min/max fields at all, only a NaN/Infinite fallback -- modifiers can push values outside legal vanilla ranges.
mayPlace refusal and crafting-remainder handling match vanilla, but recipe-book unlock tracking on craft-take (checkTakeAchievements/awardUsedRecipes) is entirely absent.
base max-stack-size and default can_insert/can_take_items match vanilla Slot.java defaults.
every named slot range index matches vanilla SlotRanges.java exactly, including the horse/crafting slot aliasing.

equipment-type placement restriction and curse-pickup gating match vanilla, but set_stack_prev is a stub (//TODO) that never calls the equivalent of onEquipItem -- equip-triggered callbacks (sound/stat/game-event hooks) never fire.
